title.sr: Preuzimanje naloga posle kupovine bez prijave
title.en: Claiming an account after a guest purchase

intro.sr: Gost koji je zakazao ili kupio bez naloga otvara link iz mejla, bira lozinku, preuzima nalog i prijavljuje se.
intro.en: A guest who booked or bought without an account opens the email link, chooses a password, claims the account and logs in.

link-iz-mejla.sr: Ko je zakazao termin ili kupio bez naloga, dobija mejl sa linkom „Preuzmite vaš nalog“. Otvaramo ga.
link-iz-mejla.en: Someone who booked or bought without an account gets an email with a “Preuzmite vaš nalog” link. We open it.

nova-lozinka.sr: Dovoljno je da izabere lozinku (najmanje 8 znakova): ime i email su već u nalogu.
nova-lozinka.en: They only need to choose a password (at least 8 characters): the name and email are already in the account.

preuzimanje-cuvanje.sr: {Kliknemo} „Preuzmi nalog“. Klik na link u mejlu je istovremeno i potvrda adrese, pa je nalog odmah aktivan, a ranije termini i porudžbine ostaju u njemu.
preuzimanje-cuvanje.en: We {click} “Preuzmi nalog”. Opening the email link also confirms the address, so the account is active at once, and the earlier appointments and orders stay in it.

prijava-novom-lozinkom.en: We log in with the new password.
